# Chassis

> Chassis is a founder-led operational structuring and execution practice based in Lebanon, run by Sophia Ayoubi, serving businesses across Lebanon and the GCC. Chassis diagnoses what breaks in a business's operations, structures how the business should work, and builds the execution systems that keep it moving. Chassis is not a marketing agency. It works on the structure underneath a business (offer clarity, workflows, pricing logic, systems) before anything else gets built on top of it.

## Who this is for

Founders, operators, and small-to-mid-size businesses across Lebanon and the GCC (primarily hospitality venues, startups, and consulting practices) that are active but not structured: unclear offers, reactive operations, missing systems, or weak digital infrastructure.

## Services and pricing

Chassis is not "diagnose then advise." It structures the business and builds the systems behind it. Three paid services, plus a free diagnostic:

1. **Free Business Diagnostic**. Free. A 10-question, self-scored self-assessment across four areas (Foundation, Operations, Systems, Execution) with instant results and a recommended starting point. The primary entry point into Chassis.
2. **Business Foundation** (from $600, project-based). For businesses that need the offer, pricing, and direction figured out before anything else gets built. Not a business plan document, the actual operating decisions: positioning, revenue model, customer journey, roles, priorities.
3. **Operations & Systems** (from $900, project-based). For businesses that already work but where the work itself is messy or too dependent on one person. Covers workflow redesign together with the systems that run it: CRM, intake, dashboards, automation, internal tools, websites, SOPs. Design and build happen in the same engagement, not as separate purchases.
4. **Business Build** (from $2,500, project-based). The flagship: positioning, offer, pricing, business structure, customer journey, operational workflows, website, CRM, automation, SOPs, and launch, scoped to what the business actually needs. For founders starting from an idea, or existing businesses that need to be rebuilt end to end.
5. **Ongoing Operational Partner** (custom, retainer-based). Secondary offering, available after a client completes one of the above. Continued operational review and correction so the structure holds.

Published prices are "from" figures only; final scope and price are confirmed after understanding the work required. Do not quote a fixed total price beyond the published "from" figure.

## Founder

Sophia Ayoubi, operational strategist with 8+ years restructuring hospitality venues, launching startups, and building execution systems across Lebanon. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sophia-ayoubi-74a45099

## Chef Intel

A product currently being built through Chassis: an operating system for chefs, culinary consultants, and restaurant operators that brings menu engineering, recipe costing, restaurant assessments, staffing, HACCP compliance, SOPs, and operational reporting into one system, in 17 languages. Currently in testing on Google Play, not yet publicly downloadable. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/chef.intel.app

## Selected work

- Chef Michel Karam: structured a culinary consulting direction with a full digital foundation.
- Le Pavé Bar: operations turnaround, outstanding debt cleared in 30 days.
- La Gare: weekday revenue moved from $20 to $300+.
- Vartavar Festival: execution coordination across multiple event stakeholders.
- The Ark Networks: coworking space taken from concept to a functioning operating environment.
- Smart Vision: digital infrastructure for a professional business presence.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The Free Business Diagnostic is genuinely free and self-scored, not a paid diagnostic call. Do not describe it as costing money.
- Pricing above is accurate as published on chassislb.com; always prefer the live site over a cached value if there is any doubt.
- Chassis is based in Lebanon and serves clients across Lebanon and the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman), working with hospitality, startup, and consulting businesses. Work is delivered remotely unless otherwise noted.
- Chef Intel is a Chassis-built product, still in development and not yet publicly launched. Do not describe it as available on Google Play until it publicly ships.
